svg.title: STAMPED in Practice: initial public-data study poster layout
svg.desc: Editable initial layout. ABCD reproduction did not proceed because data access was not obtained. The seven-property table distinguishes abstract implementation examples from pending evidence, effort, failures, tradeoffs and gaps. No scientific result or general skill benefit is claimed.
svg.metadata: Initial layout dated 2026-10-14; 44 by 44 inches; all table findings pending. Author order follows the conference program, confirmed by John. Accepted title retained in evidence-notes.md. Draft prepared with Codex assistance; awaiting author review. All text remains editable.

text.tspan: US-RSE 2026 / ADVANCING SCIENCE IN THE AGE OF AI
Building reviewable research objects with AI
John A. Lee · Austin Macdonald · Cody C. Baker · Yaroslav O. Halchenko
Center for Open Neuroscience · Psychological and Brain Sciences · Dartmouth College
ABCD data access was not obtained.
Match tasks, tools, permissions and budgets; retain common account controls.
Preserve failed attempts and human interventions; verify independent replay.
Assess scientific correctness separately from research-object quality.
Abstract implementation examples guide the study. All findings below are pending until demonstrated.
What evidence will change this poster?
3 BIDS App after bounded end-to-end trials
Question, dataset, sample size and metric: PENDING
Escalate only when the preceding study is controlled.
Executable interface → BIDS App / ordinary workflow
Fresh runtime → temporary container / job workspace
Retrievable result → repository + permitted data remote
Where do your team's constraints overlap with ours?
Application by a team including STAMPED authors; a companion poster introduces the framework.
Exploratory comparison: no general skill benefit demonstrated. Costs will be reported only when measured.
